summary:
This game is your chance to experience
the world outside of our solar system!
details: Get ready, and dive into real science aboard your ship. This is the ultimate gamified space simulation experience. Find your way through millions of mathematically accurate, procedurally generated star systems as you fight for humanity's last hope. Embark on our quest to save the human race! Navigate systems and discover an endless amount of (not yet) unique planets, moons, stars and other celestial objects, The Next Sky for humanity to gaze up at for centuries to come. All celestial bodies are obeying real life orbiting mechanics and gravity. Each body can be fully explored with unique atmospheric pressure, temperature and chemical composition. All of the air and crust will contain different elements. Each planet you land on will be a completely different, harsh world, supplying you with resources, bringing you one step closer to paradise.
